senses.gloss: m., pl. אִסְקְרִין (סקר = זקר) [the hopper,] iskra, name of a species of locusts born without legs.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 65a">Ḥull. 65ᵃ</cite> Ar. a. Rashi sing., ed. pl.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 537">Yalk. Lev. 537</cite> (corr. acc.). V. <cite ref="G00249"><he>זַחַל</he></cite>.
